cbt.summary.intro:
The KBO has completed its {season} competitive balance tax review using the opening-day salary snapshot. The league office measured domestic player payrolls and identified the clubs above the financial threshold.

The threshold was {threshold_text}. Each club was measured by its top {top_player_count} domestic salaries. Of {clubs_reviewed} clubs reviewed, {violations} finished above the line, with total tax due at {total_tax_text}.

cbt.summary.intro.v2:
Before the first stack of box scores could define the season, the league office closed the {season} payroll ledger. The competitive balance tax line was set at {threshold_text}, using each club's top {top_player_count} domestic salaries.

Across {clubs_reviewed} reviewed clubs, {violations} crossed the threshold. The total bill comes to {total_tax_text}.
cbt.summary.no_violations: This year's ledger closed quietly. No club crossed the threshold, leaving the {season} CBT review without a tax bill or repeat-offender warning.
cbt.summary.no_violations.v1: This year's ledger closed quietly. No club crossed the threshold, leaving the {season} CBT review without a tax bill or repeat-offender warning.
cbt.summary.no_violations.v2: Every club stayed inside the line. There will be no CBT collection for {season}, and the amateur assignment order remains untouched by the tax rules.
cbt.summary.draft_penalty: The repeat rule remains in effect: clubs with at least {draft_penalty_min_consecutive} consecutive over-threshold seasons also lose {draft_penalty_stages} stage(s) of amateur assignment priority.
